newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers CEO Miller to leave company.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers CEO Miller to leave company.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Monday that chairman and chief executive officer Alan Miller will be leaving the company later this year following the specialty retailer's emergence from bankruptcy.
Miller, who led the company's successful turnaround efforts, will continue to run Edison Brothers until a successor is named, the company said in a news release.
"Edison's reorganization has stabilized the business, significantly increased its value and improved the company's prospects for the future," Miller said in a statement.
Miller, 44, was named chairman and chief executive officer of the company in April 1995.
A confirmation hearing on Edison's plan of reorganization is scheduled for August 14. Edison said it expects to emerge from Chapter 11 within 30 days of the plan's confirmation.
Edison operates more than 1,700 stores in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
